newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HPL, Pidemco sign Canary Wharf venture.
newsitem.headline: HPL, Pidemco sign Canary Wharf venture.

text.p: Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL), Pidemco Land Ltd and Canary Wharf Ltd (CWL) signed a joint venture agreement on Wednesday to develop a 4.6 hectare prime site at Canary Wharf in London's Docklands, Pidemco said.
In a statement, it said HPL would take a 50 percent stake in the project known as the Canary Wharf Riverside Development.
Pidemco Land and CWL would have a 30 percent and 20 percent stake respectively, the statement said.
It said the cost of the first phase of the development was estimated at 165 million sterling (Singapore $380 million).
The first stage of the waterfront site overlooking the River Thames would include luxury condominiums, a five-star hotel, leisure and retail facilities.
The whole development would be built in various phases over six years, it said.
The statement said the venture would be the first major development project in Britain for both HPL and Pidemco.
Pidemco, currently owned by the Singapore government but due for eventual privatisation, is one of the biggest property owners and developers in Singapore.
